Anna University Placements 2025

Anna University placement 2025 report has not been published yet, but as per the latest NIRF 2026 report submitted by Anna University. In 2025, placements around 1,792 out of 3,062 graduating students were placed across its 4 main campuses, CEG, MIT, ACT, and SAP, showing an overall placement rate of nearly 58.5%. The UG (4-year) median package stands at INR 7.5 LPA. Anna University highest package is INR 53 LPA in B.Tech (CSE). 

AU in Chennai placements are managed by the Centre for University-Industry Collaboration (CUIC), which coordinates campus recruitment across IT, core engineering, banking, consulting, and public sector sectors. The top recruiters were Amazon, Apple, Barclays, Bosch, Ford, and more.

Most Commonly Question Asked

What is the median salary for Anna University BTech?
According to the NIRF 2026 report, the median salary for 4-year UG B.E./B.Tech graduates in 2025 stands at an impressive INR 7.5 LPA, with a total of 1,289 students successfully placed across various sectors.
What is the highest package at Anna University 2025?
The highest package for the 2025 batch reached INR 53 LPA. This top-tier offer was successfully secured by a student in the B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) program, reflecting the high industry demand for tech roles.

Most Commonly Question Asked

What is the overall placement percentage for Anna University?
The overall placement rate across all main campuses for the 2025 batch is 58.5%. Specifically, 1,792 students were placed out of the 3,062 graduating students across the university's undergraduate and postgraduate degree programs.

Anna University Programme-wise Placement 2025

Anna University placement 2025 spans four programme types. Anna University UG 4-year B.E./B.Tech students led with 1,289 placed and INR 7.5 LPA median. PG 2-year ME/M.Tech, MBA, and MCA students recorded 469 placements at INR 6 LPA median.

Most Commonly Question Asked

Why are placement numbers low for Integrated MSc students?
The placement rate for the 5-year Integrated M.Sc. is only 30.4% because a vast majority of these graduates intentionally opt out of campus recruitment drives to pursue dedicated research opportunities or higher education instead.

Anna University Top Recruiters 2025

Anna University placement companies include Amazon, Apple, Microsoft, Google, Barclays, BNP Paribas, Bosch, Ford, and Siemens, managed by CUIC. Over 108 companies visited the campus in the 2024 season, generating 750 job offers across IT, BFSI, core engineering, and consulting sectors.

Anna University Placement Cell & Training Support

The Centre for University-Industry Collaboration (CUIC) manages all placements for CEG, MIT, ACT, and SAP students. It coordinates pre-placement training, aptitude workshops, group discussions, and campus drives. CUIC also facilitates paid internships from the 3rd semester onwards, with top internship partners including Boeing India, Goldman Sachs, Barclays, TVS Motor, BP, and Caterpillar.

  • Workshops on resume writing
  • Mock interviews with industry experts
  • Internship programs leading to jobs
  • Collaboration with companies for skill courses
  • Online portal for registration and updates
Read More

Most Commonly Question Asked

Which cell manages campus placements at Anna University campuses?
Placements across the four main campuses (CEG, MIT, ACT, and SAP) are centrally managed by the Centre for University-Industry Collaboration (CUIC). They coordinate recruitment drives across IT, core engineering, banking, and consulting sectors.

Placement Opportunities

Placement Placement Rate: Around 80-90% of students are placed. Average Package: The average salary package offered is around 3.5 LPA. Highest Salary Package: The highest salary package offered is 12.5 LPA. Recruiting Companies: Top recruiting companies include Wipro, TCS, and Amazon. Internship Opportunities: Students also have opportunities for internships through Internshala. Median Salary: The median salary package for UG students is around Rs. 3.20 LPA and for PG is Rs. 3.20 LPA. Student Awards: Paavai Engineering College has a program where students receive the "Intenshala Student Partner" award and stipend from internships through Internshala. University Ranks: 28 students secured University ranks in Anna University examination during the academic year 2016-2017. Placement Eligibility: Students become eligible for placements from the 7th semester onwards. Location: Paavai Engineering College is located in Namakkal, Tamil Nadu. Affiliation: It is affiliated to Anna University and part of the Paavai Institutions. Courses: Paavai Engineering College offers various UG and PG courses, including B.Tech programs. Specializations: Major specializations include Aeronautical Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science Engineering, Automobile Engineering, Pharmaceutical engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Food Technology, and Electronics & Communication Engineering.

Can I join Anna University directly?

T
Triparna Choudhury •  May-23-2023
No, Anna University admissions are offered on the basis of entrance exam scores followed by a counselling process. For admission to B.Tech courses, you have to register for TNEA counselling. For Anna University admissions to PG courses such as M.Tech and MBA, you have to appear and qualify in CEETA-PG and TANCET, respectively.

Anna University Placements FAQs

Are students trained for placements at Anna University by the CUIC?

Yes, the placement cell plans campus placements, industrial training, field trips, projects, and other events to get students ready for the hiring process.

How many students were placed in Anna University placements 2022?

A total of around 2,000 students were placed during Anna University placements in the year 2022.

What was the highest salary package earned by the students at Anna University placements 2022?

At the Anna University placement 2022, the highest salary package offered to the students was Rs 36.50 LPA. The highest salary package previously was Rs 20.50 LPA for the Anna University placements in 2021 and Rs 39 LPA for the placements in 2020.

Which industry has hired the most Anna University students?

The engineering sector has hired the most graduates of Anna University.

Does the university provide placement opportunities to its students?

Yes, Anna University students are offered numerous job opportunities every year.
